cards.title: git pull
cards.body: When someone else pushes to GitHub, your copy falls behind. `git pull` downloads their commits and merges them into your branch.

hi.title: git pull
hi.body: Jab koi aur GitHub par push karta hai, aapki copy peeche reh jaati hai. `git pull` unke commits download karke aapki branch mein merge kar deta hai.

cards.title: Pull before you push
cards.body: If GitHub has work you don't, Git rejects your push until you pull it first.

hi.title: Push se pehle pull
hi.body: Agar GitHub par aisa kaam hai jo aapke paas nahi, toh Git aapka push tab tak reject karta hai jab tak aap pehle pull na karo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: A teammate pushed first, so GitHub rejects this push. Tap the line that needs a step before it.
cards.code:
git add notes.txt
git commit -m "Fix typo"
git push

bug.fix: When GitHub has work you do not, pull first: `git pull`, then `git push`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Ek teammate ne pehle push kar diya, isliye GitHub yeh push reject karta hai. Us line par tap karo jisse pehle ek step chahiye.
hi.fix: Jab GitHub par aisa kaam ho jo aapke paas nahi, pehle pull karo: `git pull`, phir `git push`.

check.question: Git rejected your push with "fetch first". What do you do?
check.explanation: Pulling brings in the other commits; then your push goes through.

hi.question: Git ne "fetch first" ke saath aapka push reject kar diya. Aap kya karoge?
hi.explanation: Pull karne se doosre commits aa jaate hain; phir aapka push chala jaata hai.

exercise.prompt: A teammate pushed a new commit to GitHub. You are in your copy, `notes`. Pull their work.
exercise.promptHi: Ek teammate ne GitHub par naya commit push kiya. Aap apni copy, `notes`, mein ho. Unka kaam pull karo.
